subject: OneTrust legacy evidence migration — ownership & chain-of-custody plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@acme-inc.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-inc.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Legacy evidence migration to OneTrust - quick context and ask

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Acme Payments is consolidating several vendor security profiles (old Whistic + a small Vendr export) into our OneTrust tenant. We have a ~1.8k item evidence index (CSV attached) and a handful of larger artifacts sitting in an internal S3 bucket.

Questions we want to confirm with Redwood before we start the inbound upload window:
- Can Redwood accept a CSV manifest + presigned S3 uploads for bulk intake into OneTrust?
- Do you require proof-of-possession chaining (signed hash or documented owner field) for each item to preserve CAIQ/SIG traceability?
- Any constraints on retention metadata (we have a retention column per file that we'd like to preserve in OneTrust fields).

The timeline is tight — our security team is asking for a two-week migration window starting 7/20. If Redwood has a recommended mapping template (CAIQ -> OneTrust field) that would speed this up, please send it.

Attached: current_evidence_index.csv (manifest, includes filename, md5, owner_email, retention_days)

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Payments

---

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@acme-inc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Legacy evidence migration to OneTrust - quick context and ask

Lena — thanks for the clear manifest, that helps. High level: we can support the flow you describe but need to lock down ownership handback and an audit trail for chain-of-custody. Proposed approach (short):

1) Inventory mapping: Redwood will map CSV columns to our OneTrust ingestion template (we'll preserve owner_email and retention_days as metadata fields). We'll return a mapping CSV for your sign-off.
2) Presigned uploads: Our staging S3 accepts presigned PUTs; we will generate short-lived presigns (max 24h) for the window. Files uploaded must match md5 hashes in your manifest.
3) Proof-of-possession: For any file >5MB or policy documents, we request a signed hash (simple PGP detached signature or signed JSON with owner and timestamp). This keeps CAIQ evidence provenance intact.
4) Roll-forward: After ingestion we run a QA pass (checksum and metadata compare) and provide an evidence-handback manifest with timestamps and our internal audit log link.

I'll attach the draft S3 presign policy we usually use for bulk onboarding. If that looks good, Marissa and Ben can coordinate the staging bucket and the migration window scheduling.

Attachments: s3-presign-policy-draft.pdf

Next steps: Marissa — can you pick a 3-day staging window between 7/20–7/31 for the presign issuance and QA run? Ben — can you confirm the audit-log retention and whether we can provide a signed chain-of-custody CSV back to Acme?

Jonas Weber
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Thanks Jonas and Lena — looping in the migration playbook and a short mutual action plan so everyone has the same runbook. Quick clarifications:

- Mapping template: Jonas, I've uploaded the CAIQ->OneTrust mapping CSV to our playbook (link below). Lena, please review and note any custom fields you must keep (e.g., internal risk score).
- DocuSign: Because custody is changing, we ask for a short SOW amendment that covers temporary access and upload responsibilities; we're happy to route via DocuSign to avoid manual signatures. Link below.
- Staging window: Proposed dates 7/22–7/24 (3 business days) — this gives Acme a day to upload and us two days for QA and handback. If Acme cannot meet that window due to internal approvals, propose alternate dates.

Playbook excerpt: we use checksum verification + owner_email match to mark evidence as accepted. Anything failing checksum is quarantined and we provide an exceptions CSV.

DocuSign (SOW amendment): https://na1.docusign.net/DocuSign/secure/example?documentId=xyz123
Mapping playbook: https://redwood.app/playbooks/onetrust-legacy-migration

Lena — can you confirm 1) approval to the proposed 7/22–7/24 window and 2) whether Acme will provide PGP-signed hashes for files >5MB or if you want us to accept signed JSON statements instead?

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
